movers.text: Starting PG Landen Joseph (26.5 mpg) hurt his right ankle late in the 63-46 win over Utah on 11/20 and left on crutches; no update before the Northwestern game.
Starter Neo Avdalas (24 mpg, team-high 3.8 apg) fractured his left wrist vs. Georgia and had surgery; UNC says he is out about two months (announced 11/17).
Northwestern lost F Ryan Soulis (11 mpg) for the season (foot surgery, hurt 11/13 vs DePaul); big man Luke McEldon is also out, leaving Okku Federiko and 7-3 Symon Ghai at center.
